seiyuuQuiz.subtitle: Per-seiyuu question banks · 12 questions each
seiyuuQuiz.intro: Search for a voice actress first, then answer questions drawn from her own bank — career, hobbies, skills, anecdotes and relationships included. Answers stay hidden while you play: the score, grade and comment come at the end.
seiyuuQuiz.guide: Every question has four options and exactly one correct answer. Each seiyuu has her own bank covering experiences, hobbies, specialities, trivia and the roles she has played. Quick and Love modes draw questions at random; Solo mode walks the whole bank. Wrong answers come with explanations on the score sheet.
